source_refs.note: Book p. 276: 14.3.2 Parallel Vectors, u x v = 0 iff sin theta = 0 or a zero vector, cases (i), (ii) and the Note box on the zero vector.

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne dekha ke \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) ki lambai \(|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta\) hai. Ab sawal yeh hai: agar dono vectors ek hi seedh mein hon (parallel), to kya hoga? Is sabaq mein yahi dekhenge, aur parallel vectors pehchanne ka ek aasan test bhi milega.
Agar \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) parallel vectors hain, to un ke darmiyan angle \(\theta = 0\) hai, aur \(\sin 0 = 0\). Is liye

Kyun: \(\sin\theta = 0\) ho to poora hissa \(|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta\) zero ho jata hai, aur zero ko kisi bhi unit vector \(\underline{n}\) se zarb dein to zero vector \(\underline{0}\) hi bachta hai.

Ab ulta sochiye: agar \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \underline{0}\) ho, to kya kehna sakte hain? Teen cheezon ka product zero hai, to in mein se koi ek zero hogi:
\[\text{either } \sin\theta = 0\]
\[\text{or } |\underline{u}| = 0 \quad\text{or}\quad |\underline{v}| = 0\]

items: (i) Agar \(\sin\theta = 0\) to \(\theta = 0^{\circ}\) ya \(180^{\circ}\). Is ka matlab hai ke vectors \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) parallel hain (ek hi seedh mein, chahe ek taraf ho ya ulti taraf).

(ii) Agar \(\underline{u} = \underline{0}\) ya \(\underline{v} = \underline{0}\), to zero vector ki koi khaas direction nahin hoti, is liye hum yeh convention (mutafiqa qaida) maan lete hain ke zero vector har vector ke parallel hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab ka note: zero vector har vector ke parallel bhi hai aur perpendicular bhi. Yeh bazahir ulti baat (contradiction) koi masla nahin banati, kyun ke jab ek vector zero ho to do vectors ke darmiyan angle ka istemal kabhi kiya hi nahin jata.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(180^{\circ}\) bhi parallel kyun? Socho ek seedhi sarak par do gaariyan, ek shumal (north) ki taraf, doosri junoob (south) ki taraf. Rukh ulta hai magar dono ek hi line par hain. Aise vectors ko anti-parallel bhi kehte hain, aur \(\sin 180^{\circ} = 0\) bhi hai.
Is se ek aasan test mil gaya: do non-zero vectors parallel tabhi hain jab \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \underline{0}\).
Is ko 14.2 se milaiye: do non-zero vectors perpendicular tabhi hain jab \(\underline{u} \cdot \underline{v} = 0\). Dono test yaad rakhiye, imtihan mein dono poochhe jate hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ka sawal nahin.) \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) aur \(\underline{v} = 2\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\). Ghaur karein: \(\underline{v}\) ke har component \(\underline{u}\) ke components ka do guna hai, yani \(\underline{v} = 2\underline{u}\). To yeh parallel hain.
14.3.5 ka determinant formula lagayein to: \(\underline{i}\) wala hissa \(2 \cdot 6 - 3 \cdot 4 = 0\), \(\underline{j}\) wala \(-(1 \cdot 6 - 3 \cdot 2) = 0\), \(\underline{k}\) wala \(1 \cdot 4 - 2 \cdot 2 = 0\). Yani \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \underline{0}\). Test ne bhi parallel hi bataya.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Kya \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u}\) bhi zero vector hoga? (Jawab: haan, kyun ke har vector apne aap ke parallel hai, \(\theta = 0\). Yahi baat 14.3.3 (d) mein aayegi.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Parallel vectors (\(\theta = 0^{\circ}\) ya \(180^{\circ}\)) ka cross product \(\underline{0}\) hai.
2. Non-zero vectors ke liye: \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \underline{0}\) tabhi jab \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) parallel hon.
3. Zero vector ko har vector ke parallel (aur perpendicular bhi) maana jata hai.
4. Dot zero: perpendicular. Cross zero: parallel.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = 0\) (number) likh dena jab ke jawab \(\underline{0}\) (zero vector) hai. Cross product ka jawab hamesha vector hota hai, zero ho tab bhi.
2. \(\theta = 180^{\circ}\) ko bhool jana: ulti direction wale vectors bhi parallel hain.
3. Dono test mila dena: dot product zero ka matlab perpendicular, cross product zero ka matlab parallel. Ulta mat kijiye.
